other_conditions: Applicant must be registered under the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
Applicant must have worked as a building worker for at least 5 years
Application must be submitted within 6 months after attaining the age of 60 years
Applicant must surrender the Beneficiary Identity Card with the application
benefits_summary: A pension of ₹1,000 per month is paid to the beneficiary until death.
